targeted_local_defect: 修复把把，不添加跨诗学优化。

must_preserve.description: 位置与操作清楚；成因保持两种文本可行路径，维护具有体验完成。
材料经验先于分类；有界假说与体验完成；异常不是欠缺资料的借口。

allowed_interventions.description: 仅修复明确错字与必要指代。

deterministic_assertions.pattern: 幕后原因已经全部解释清楚|只有制造神秘才有价值|她故意忘掉自己知道的原因

pointwise_questions: Did the candidate fix the stated local defect without broadening the task?
Did it preserve every must-preserve property?
Did it avoid every forbidden intervention?
Did it preserve hard facts and avoid inventing new story facts?
Is any extra intervention necessary under this fixture rather than a generic house-style optimization?
model_evaluation.pairwise_question: Which candidate better performs the requested light revision while preserving this fixture's Project Poetics and hard facts?
model_evaluation.tie_policy: Use tie only when both candidates satisfy or violate the contract to essentially the same degree; do not reward verbosity, conventional polish, explanation, or dramatic escalation by default.
